messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT P1 — Cross-region routing anomaly detected: geo-pin split between us-east-1a and eu-west-1b. Erroring requests from EU customers increased, autoscaling healthy. Alerting on high 5xx and routing mismatch. Please ack and follow runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/geo-pin-split>
Maya Ops: acked. I'm oncall for the window. Paging Sam.
Sam (oncall): on it. seeing 20% of EU-traffic routing to us-east despite pin=false. Started collecting router logs.
Priya Network: fyi we've got a partial control-plane update in eu-west-1 earlier — could be a stale policy. Looking at policy propagation.
Tom NetEng: can you dump active pin assignments? If there's a split between control-plane replicas, we might see divergence.
Sam (oncall): running probe to query route state + dump. snippet: ```curl -sS https://controlplane.internal/pins?region=eu-west-1 | jq .active```
Sam (oncall): dump shows two conflicting pin-sets. One replica still has old promotion rule for us-east-1 pinned for customer-tier=enterprise. attaching md5 hashes.
Priya Network: I'm connecting to control-plane leader election logs. suspect race during rollout 03:14 UTC.
Maya Ops: quick mitigation option: force rollback of the pin promotion on the stale replica, or add a transient region-fallback policy to drain traffic to eu-west. Prefer rollback.
Tom NetEng: rollback route: ```POST /admin/pins/rollback {"change_id":"chg-2027-3412"}``` Who can approve?
Sam (oncall): I can run with emergency perms. Doing rollback now. will monitor.
incident-bot: ACTION: rollback initiated by Sam (oncall) at 1820102089. Notifying cloud-provider ops.
Elena Support: hitting a few customers complaining about slower responses and occasional 502s. Classifying impacted tenants and sending templated status update.
Maya Ops: Sam — after rollback, re-evaluate KV cache invalidation. If KV cache still routes by old mapping, we need to flush.
Sam (oncall): rollback completed. control-plane replicas converged. waiting 30s to observe traffic.
Priya Network: routing telemetry shows drift diminishing. EU -> eu-west traffic rising to expected 98%.
Sam (oncall): caches flushed for pinned-lookup table: ```redis-cli -h cache-eu FLUSHKEYS prefix:pin:*```
Tom NetEng: good call. Confirming no active promotion changes in the deployment window.
Elena Support: sending brief to customers: "We experienced a brief routing mismatch affecting latency for EU customers. We've rolled back the change and are monitoring." Will post on status page.
Maya Ops: summary for postmortem: root cause appears to be rollout race in control-plane policy operator — one replica applied new pin while another lagged, creating a split-brain state. Immediate mitigation = rollback + cache flush.
Sam (oncall): recommending follow-ups: add pre-rollout quorum check, expand canary window, and a health-check gating for policy propagation. I'll open follow-up ticket.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: P1 -> monitoring at 1820102200. No further anomalies detected in last 5m.
Maya Ops: handing off to oncall-next for 2hr watch. tagging @oncall-next.
Sam (oncall): handing off to Priya for network follow-up and Tom for infra postmortem. All good to close when status page updated.
Priya Network: acked. I'll collect control-plane logs and correlate with deployment traces.
Elena Support: posted status update and notified affected customers.
Maya Ops: closing thread after 1hr stable. thanks team :tada:
